title: Sublative Personal Pronouns: rám, rád, rá...

sections.content:
The sublative case (*-ra / -re*, meaning 'onto' or directional motion toward a surface) has short, monosyllabic personal forms based on the stem **rá-**:
- **rám** = (onto) me / at me / for me
- **rád** = (onto) you (singular)
- **rá** = (onto) him / her / it
- **ránk** = (onto) us
- **rátok** = (onto) you (plural)
- **rájuk** = (onto) them

items.english: Wait for me in front of the entrance!
